# Mayan Origin

> Specialty coffee and traditional foods from Honduras, rooted in Mayan heritage. Ships to the United States.

Mayan Origin is a direct-to-consumer brand sourcing single-origin coffee and traditional Honduran products from small cooperatives in Copán and Marcala, Honduras. Every order is packed fresh in Honduras and shipped to the US.

## Products

### Coffee

- **Balam (El Jaguar)** — Dark roast. Washed process. Copán, Honduras. 1,400–1,600 masl. Notes of dark chocolate, smoky cedar, and dried cherry. From $18 (250g). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/balam/
- **Ixchel (La Diosa de la Luna)** — Light roast. Natural process. Copán, Honduras. 1,500–1,700 masl. Notes of jasmine, white peach, and honey finish. From $19 (250g). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/ixchel/
- **Kukulkan (La Serpiente Emplumada)** — Medium roast. Honey process. Copán, Honduras. 1,350–1,550 masl. Notes of brown sugar, toasted almond, and citrus. From $17 (250g). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/kukulkan/

All coffees are available in 250g, 500g, and 1kg sizes.

## Brand

- Founded to bring Honduran specialty coffee and traditional foods to the US market
- Products named after Mayan gods: Balam (jaguar god), Ixchel (moon goddess), Kukulkan (feathered serpent)
- Sourced from CAFICO and COCAFCAL cooperatives in Copán and Marcala, Honduras
- Grown at high altitude (1,350–1,700 masl) by smallholder farmers
- Every order packed fresh in Honduras

## Where to Buy

All products ship from Honduras to the United States.

Shop: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/

## Content

The Mayan Origin blog covers:
- Mayan history and gods (Kukulkan, Ixchel, Balam)
- Honduran coffee origins (Copán, Marcala)
- Recipes using Honduran ingredients (hot chocolate, vanilla extract)
- Coffee brewing guides (French press, pour over)

Blog: https://mayanorigin.com/blog/
